name: Synchronized
description: A runway walk down a brutalist colonnade where every step splits off a perfect clone.

wardrobe.man: a bold red belted trench coat over black trousers and black boots
wardrobe.woman: a bold red belted trench coat over black trousers and black ankle boots
wardrobe.person: a bold red belted trench coat over black trousers and black boots

scene_prompt: Create a new cinematic film still in {aspect_words} format. {references} The {subject} is the only person in the new still, with exactly {their} face, eyes, nose, jaw, hairline, hairstyle, hair colour{facial_hair}, skin tone and build{identity_notes}. The clothing, the place and the light come only from this description. The {subject} walks straight toward the camera down the center of a long brutalist concrete colonnade, mid-stride, wearing {wardrobe}. Massive raw concrete pillars repeat in perfect rhythm on both sides and recede to a bright opening far behind; soft overcast daylight falls between the pillars and pools on the smooth concrete floor. Wide symmetrical one-point perspective at eye level, the full body in the center filling about a third of the frame height, generous empty floor on both sides. Cinematic fashion film still, muted grey concrete palette with the red coat as the only strong color. Correct human anatomy, natural skin texture, sharp focus on the {subject}, bare concrete surfaces throughout.
effect_prompt: Use the provided start image as the first frame. The {subject} is ALREADY walking toward the camera down the center of the colonnade in a precise, confident "runway walk", one foot placed in front of the other, gaze locked on a point just past the camera, and never breaks stride. With every step a perfect clone separates from {their} body, one to the left, then one to the right, each clone in the same red trench coat with the same face and hair, and every clone walks in exact lockstep, the same foot landing at the same instant. By the end of the shot exactly SEVEN identical copies of the {subject} walk toward the camera together in a V formation, the original at the point of the V and three clones fanned out behind on each side, all perfectly synchronized. CLONE COUNT LOCK: seven figures in the final frame; any other number = failed take. The camera tracks backward at walking pace, keeping the formation centered. Sound: each clone separates with a soft airy whoosh, and the footsteps multiply into one sharp synchronized rhythm echoing off the concrete. Photorealistic, cinematic fashion-film visual effects, consistent identity across every clone, sharp detail, stable picture.
generic_prompt: Use the provided start image as the first frame. The {subject} in the frame carries on with the same action and the same pace. Immediately a perfect clone separates from {their} body to the left, then another to the right, and one more every second after that, each clone with the same face, hair and clothes, every clone moving in exact sync with the original. By the end of the shot exactly SEVEN identical copies of the {subject} stand or move together in a V formation, the original at the point of the V and three clones fanned out behind on each side. CLONE COUNT LOCK: seven figures in the final frame; any other number = failed take. The camera keeps the same framing and the same movement it already has. Sound: each clone separates with a soft airy whoosh, and the footsteps multiply into one synchronized rhythm. Photorealistic, cinematic visual effects, consistent identity across every clone, sharp detail, stable picture.
